The FloPlast uPVC half round stop end outlet in black provides an essential component for effective rainwater drainage systems. This 112mm gutter stop end with a 68mm downpipe connection is ideal for both new-build projects and refurbishment work on various properties. Constructed from durable uPVC, it offers a long-lasting and low-maintenance solution. Installation is simplified by pre-lubricated seals and a pre-fitted gutter seal retaining clip system, ensuring a secure and leak-free fit. Its robust design is compatible with many existing rainwater systems, making it a reliable choice for trade professionals seeking efficient guttering solutions.
